scope: Visual water response only; no added tank buoyancy, chassis drag or lava damage.

method.reusableScriptNote: The reusable script completed successfully with all five driving assertions true and no console or page errors. It names box roles and identifies the observed tank from the dev controls.
method.tank: Actual player tank placed with Engine playground's Place tank here control, then driven with KeyW.
method.contact: Live GPU water probes at each kit box centre, compared with the radial ray-box intersection. Body/leftTrack/rightTrack are the presenter's documented local box roles.
method.drivingSample: After an initial 800 ms keyboard hold; browser wall time and simulation ticks can differ.

units: Lengths in world units, speed in world units per second, foam in [0,1].

validation.visualReview: The driving screenshot visibly shows spray beside and behind the immersed right track.

limits: Centre-ray probes do not prove that every point of the body footprint is dry.
The sloping right-track cell was deeper than 0.22 world units; this is not a uniformly shallow flat-water test.
Initial foam includes the placement disturbance. No before-versus-old-code visual comparison was recorded.
sprayEmitted telemetry currently counts requested bursts, not grid droplets; the screenshot, not that counter, confirms contact spray.

Whole-planet water has open-sea relaxation and hull displacement, so this browser run is not a closed-volume conservation measurement. The focused CPU test isolates the wake flux and reverse-slot volume exchange.
Raw logs and screenshots are local capture artifacts regenerated by the verification command.
